text.body: prapratyapiparāpopaparyanvavavisaṃsvati | nirnyudadhidurabhyāḍ‌ upasargāśca viṃśatiḥ || 1 || iti viṃśati upasargāḥ | eṣāṃ vṛttisūtramabhidhāsyāmaḥ | pra | ādikarmodīrṇabhṛśārthaiśvaryasaṃbhavaviyoganiyogatṛptiśuddhīcchāśaktiśāṃtipūjāgradarśaneṣu pretyayamupasarga eteṣvartheṣu vartate | ādikarmaṇi pragataḥ prabalo rājā | udīrṇe prabalā mūṣikā | bhṛśārthe pravadanti dāyādāḥ | aiśvarye prabhurdevadattaḥ | saṃbhave himavato gaṃgā prabhavati | viyoge preṣitaḥ| niyoge prayuktaḥ | tṛptau prabhuktaṃ annam‌ | śuddhau prasannamudakam‌ | icchāyāṃ prārthayate kanyām‌ | śaktau praśakto vidyāyām‌ | śāṃtau praśāṃto'gniḥ | pūjāyāṃ prāṃjali sthitaḥ | agre pravālo vṛkṣasya | darśane pralokayati kanyām‌ | ityayaṃ propasargaḥ || 1 || parā | vadhamarṣaṇagativikramābhimukhyabhṛśārthāprādhānyavimokṣaprātilomyeṣu | parā ityayamupasarga eteṣvartheṣu vartate | vadhe parāghātaḥ | marṣaṇe parāmṛṣū | gatau parāgataḥ | vikrame parākrāntaḥ | abhimukhye parāvṛttaḥ | bhṛśārthe parājitaḥ | apradhāne parādhīnaḥ | vimokṣe parākṣataḥ | prātilomye parāṅmukhaḥ || 2 || apa | varjanaviyogacauryaharṣanirddeśavikṛtivāraṇaviparyayeṣu | ayamapopasarga eteṣvartheṣu vartate | varjane apasāṃkāśyādṛṣṭo devaḥ | viyoge apayāti | caurye apaharati | nirddeśe apadiśati | vikṛtau'pakṛtam‌ | vāraṇa apasarati | viparyaye apaśabdaḥ || 3 || sam‌ | yogaaikyaprabhvasatyasamaṃtatobhāvavibhūṣaṇābhimukhyaśleṣasiddhikrodhasvīkaraṇeṣu | samayaṃ upasarga eteṣvartheṣu vartate | yoge saṃgataḥ putreṇa | viyoge saṃviyuktaḥ priyeṇa | aikye saṃpravadanti mukhyāḥ | prabhave saṃbhavati agniḥ kāṣṭhaiḥ | satya saṃvādaḥ | samakṣe saṃkathā vartate | samaṃtatābhāve saṃkīrṇaḥ | bhūṣaṇe saṃskṛtā kanyā | abhimukhye saṃmukhaṃ vartate | śleṣe saṃdhate kāryam‌| siddhau saṃsiddhiḥ | krodhe saṃkṛddhaḥ | svīkaraṇe saṃgṛhṇāti || 4|| anu | paścādbhāvādhiṣṭhānasāmīpyasvādhyāyānubaṃdhavisargasādṛśyābhimukhyalakṣaṇahīneṣu | ityanūpasarga eteṣvartheṣu vartate | paścādbhāve anurathaṃ padātayaḥ | adhiṣṭhāne anuṣṭhānaṃ pāṭaliputram‌ | sāmīpye amumeghaṃ gaganam‌ | svādhyāye vyākaraṇamanuvadati | anubaṃdhe anuśayaḥ | visarge anujñāto gacchati | sādṛśye anukṛtiḥ | ābhimukhye anuvatso mātaraṃ dhāvati | lakṣaṇe anuvanamasau nirgataḥ | hīne anvarjanaṃ yoddhāraḥ || 5 || ava | vijñānāvalaṃbane śuddhīṣadarthavyāptiparibhavaviyogeṣu avetyayamupasarga eteṣvartheṣu vartate | vijñāne avagato'rthaḥ | avalaṃbane avaṣṭabhya yaṣṭiṃ gacchati | śuddhau avadāttaṃ mukham | īṣadarthe avabhuktam | vyāptau avakīrṇaṃ pāṃśubhiḥ | paribhave avahasati | viyoge avamuktā kāntā || 6 || nir‌ | viyogabhṛśārthapāpātyayāvadhāraṇādeśātikramalābheṣu nirityupasarga ayameteṣu artheṣu vartate | viyoge niḥśalyam | bhṛśārthe nirnītaḥ | pāpe nirmaryādaḥ | atyaye nirdādhaṃ gamanam | avadhāraṇe niścitaḥ | ādeśe nirdiṣṭaḥ | atikrame niḥkrāṃtaḥ | lābhe nirviśeṣaḥ || 7 || dur‌ | īṣadarthakutsanavaivarṇyāsaṃpatyalābheṣu durityayamupasarga eteṣvartheṣu vartate | īṣadarthe durgṛhītaḥ | kutsane durbalaḥ | vaivarṇye durvarṇaḥ | asaṃpattau durgataḥ | alābhe duḥprāpyaḥ || 8 || vi | nānārthaviyogātiśayabhayadūrārthabhṛthārthakalahaiśvaryamohapauśūnyotkarṣakutsaneṣadarthānābhimukhyānavasthānāprādhānyadarśanaśauryeṣu | vi ityayaṃ upasarga eteṣvartheṣu vartate | nānārthe vicitrā kṛtiḥ pāṇineḥ | viyoge viyuktaḥ | atiśaye vikīrṇaḥ | bhaye vibhīṣaṇaḥ | īṣadarthe viprakṛṣṭamadhvānam | bhṛśārthe visuddhā nadī | kalahe vibhajya dhanam | aiśvarye vibhurdevadattasya | mohe vimanaskaḥ | paiśūnye vikaraḥ | utkarṣe vismito devadattaḥ | kutsane virupaḥ | īṣadarthe vilopitaḥ | anābhimukhye vimukhaḥ | anavasthāne vibhrāṃtaḥ | apradhānye viniṣṭaḥ | darśane vilokanīyā kanyā | śaurye vikrāṃtaḥ || 9 || āḍ‌ | prāptīcchābaṃdhanabhayavākyaśleṣābhividhisādhyakṛcchrādikarmagrahaṇanilayasāmīpyavikriyānimaṃtraṇanivṛtyāśīrādānāṃtarbhāvaspardhābhimukhyordhvakarmavismayapratiṣṭhānirddeśaśaktimaryādāsu | āḍ‌ ityupasarga eteṣvartheṣu vartate | tadyathā | prāptau āsāditamanena | icchāyāṃ ākāṃkṣati | baṃdhane āmuñcati kavacam | bhaye ākaṃpitaḥ | vākye ājñāpayati | abhividhau ākṛmāraṃ yaśa pāṇineḥ | śleṣe āliṃgayati | sādhye ācarati kapaṭena | kṛcchre āpadgataḥ | ādikarmaṇi ārabhate kartum | grahaṇe ālaṃbate | nilaye āvasatham | sāmīpye āsannaṃ kalyāṇam | vikriyāyāṃ āsvādayati | nimaṃtraṇe āmaṃtraṇam | nivṛttau āramate | āśiṣi āśāste | ādāne rasāyanam | aṃtarbhāve āpītamudakam‌ sikatābhiḥ | spardhāyāṃ mallo mallamāhvayati | ābhimukhye āgacchati devadattaḥ | urdhvakarmaṇi ārohati hastipakaḥ | vismaye ānaṃditāḥ | pratiṣṭhāyāṃ āspadam | nirdeśe ādiśati | śaktau ākramate gaganaṃ caṃdramāḥ | maryādāyāṃ āilāvardhanātsaṃpannaḥ śālayaḥ || 10 || ni | niveśarāśibhṛśārthādhobhāvanivāsaddārakarmadarśanoparamabaṃdhanakauśalyāṃtarbhāvasānīdhamokṣāśrayeṣu nirityayamupasarga eteṣvartheṣu vartate | niveśe niveśitam | rāśau nikaro dhānyasya | bhṛśārthe nigṛhītaḥ | adhobhāve nipatitaḥ | nivāse nivasito naram | dārakarmaṇi niviṣṭo devadattaḥ | darśane niśāmayati rupam | uparame nivṛtaḥ | baṃdhane niyamitaḥ | kauśalye nipuṇaḥ | aṃtarbhāve nipītamudakam‌ sikatābhiḥ | sāmīpye nikṛṣṭakālaḥ | mokṣe nisṛṣṭaḥ | āśraye nilayaḥ || 11 || adhi | vaśīkaraṇādhiṣṭhānādhyayanaiśvaryasmaraṇādhikeṣu adhi ityayaṃ upasarga eteṣvartheṣu vartate | vaśīkaraṇe adhikaroti arthī | adhiṣṭhāne adhiguṇaḥ | adhyayane adhīte vyākaraṇam | aiśvarye adhipatiḥ | smaraṇe kṣetramadhismarati | ādhikye adhikṣetre rājñaḥ || 12 || api | saṃbhāvanānivṛttiapekṣāsamuccayasaṃbhavagarhāśīramarṣaṇapraśneṣu | apītyayaṃ upasarga eteṣvartheṣu vartate | saṃbhāvane api siṃcenmūlasahasram | nivṛttau māṃsamapi juhyāt | apekṣāyāṃ athāyamapi vidvān | samuccaye tvahamapi ayamapi | saṃbhave api saṃbhavati | (ahiḥ stuhiṣu) garhāyāṃ api vṛṣalaṃ yācayet | āśiṣi api varṣaṃ śataṃ jīyāḥ | amarṣaṇe api bhajanna namet | bhūṣaṇe api nahvati hāram | praśne api gacchati || 13 || ati | atiśayabhṛśārthātikrāṃtiatikramaṇavṛddhiṣu | ati ityayamupasarga eteṣvartheṣu vartate | atiśayo atimānuṣaṃ yasya vijñānam | bhṛśārthe atitaptā āyaḥ | atikrāntau atirathim | atikramaṇe hastinātikramati | vṛddhau atimeghaṃ gaganam || 14 || su | pūjābhṛśārthānumatisamṛddhipraśaṃsākṛcchreṣu | su iti ayamupasarga eteṣvartheṣu vartate | pūjāyām‌ susādhuḥ | bhṛśārthe sutaptā āyaḥ | anumatau sukṛtam | samṛddhau sumudram | praśaṃsāyāṃ sukṛṣim | kṛcchre suduḥkaraḥ || 15 || ut‌ | prābalyaviyogordhvakarmalābhaprakāśāsvasthamokṣābhāvabaṃdhanaprādhānyaśaktiṣu | ut‌ ityayamupasarga eteṣvartheṣu vartate | prābalye udvilasatsarpaḥ | viyoge utpathena gacchati | urdhvakarmaṇi uttiṣṭhati śayanāt | lābhe utpannaṃ dravyam | prakāśe uccaranti nabhasi meghāḥ | asvasthe utsukaḥ | mokṣe udvāsaḥ | abhāve utpathaḥ | baṃdhane udbaddhā kanyā | prādhānye utkṛṣṭaḥ | śaktau utsāhaḥ || 16 || abhi | pūjāābhimukhyabhṛśārthasādṛśyaprayogavyāptinṛttasārupyavacanādānāmnāyeṣu | abhi iti ayamupasarga eteṣu artheṣu vartate | pūjāyāṃ abhivādayati | ābhimukhye abhimukhaṃ sthitaḥ | bhṛśārthe abhirataḥ | sādṛśye abhijñātaḥ | prayoge abhijānāti | icchāyāṃ abhilaṣati | vyāptau abhisyandaḥ | nṛtte abhinayaḥ | sārupye abhirupaḥ | vacane abhivacanam | ādāne'bhyavaharati | āmnāye abhyasyati || 17 || prati | sādṛśyādānahiṃsātadyogavinimayapratinidhinivṛttivyādhyābhimukhyavyāptivāraṇeṣu | pratyayamupasarga eteṣvartheṣu vartate | sādṛśye pratikṛtaṃ devadattena | ādāne pratigṛhṇāti | hiṃsāyāṃ pratiharati | tadyoge pratipannamanena | vinimayo tolanaghṛtaṃ pratidadāti | pratinidhau praticchaṃdaḥ | nivṛttau pratikrāṃtaḥ | vyādhau pratiśyāyaḥ | abhimukhye pratisūrye gacchati | vyāptau pratikīrṇaṃ pāṃśubhiḥ | vāraṇe pratinivṛttaḥ || 18 || pari | samaṃtatobhāvavyāpti doṣākhyānoparabhūṣaṇapūjāvarjanāliṃgananivasanavyādhiśokavīpsāsu | parīti ayamupasarga eteṣvartheṣu vartate | samaṃtatobhāve parikramati | vyāptau parigato'gninā grāmaḥ | doṣākhyāne paribhramati | uparame paripūrṇaḥ kuṃbhaḥ | bhūṣaṇe pariṣkaroti kanyām | pūjāyāṃ paricaryā | varjane paritrigartebhyāvṛṣṭo devadevaḥ | āliṃgane pariṣvajate kanyām | nivasano paridhānam | vyādhau parigatā sphoṭakāḥ | śoke paridevanā | vīpsāyāṃ vṛkṣaṃ vṛkṣaṃ parisiṃcati || 19 || upa | sāmīpyāsāmarthyavyāptyācāryakaraṇadoṣākhyānadānadākṣiṇyavīpsāraṃbhapūjātadyogaoratyayamaraṇeṣu | upa iti upasarga eteṣvartheṣu vartate | sāmīpye upakuṃtam | sāmarthye upakaroti devadattaḥ | vyāptau upakīrṇaṃ pāṃśubhiḥ | ācāryakaraṇe upadiśati śiṣyebhyaḥ | doṣākhyāne upaghātaḥ | dāne upaharatyarthaṃ devadattāyāḥ | dākṣiṇye upacāraḥ | vīpsāyāṃ upayācate | āraṃbhe upakramate bhoktum | pūjāyāṃ upāsitaḥ | tadyoge upapannaṃ dhyānamāha | pratyaye upapannaṃ dhanam | śaraṇe upagato devadattaḥ | pratyaye upasargadharmaḥ || 20 || iti upasargavṛttiḥ samāptā ||
